title: 天星
mood: sitting in the seat that faced the other way
subject: a nine-minute Star Ferry crossing and the flip-back bench seat
caption: Cantonese Sinogaze. A loud shoegaze guitar wall of fuzz and reverse reverb carrying a clear Cantopop melodic contour underneath the noise, slow steady drums, bass buried inside the guitars, a glockenspiel doubling the melody to cut through. Loud and guitar-saturated, louder and denser than dream pop, with the voice low in the mix. Airy female voice, soft and breathy, sitting inside the wash. 96 BPM, E major. Sitting in the seat that used to face the other way. No clean acoustic section, no synth lead, no autotune, no programmed drums, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
天星小輪 九分鐘 尖沙咀到中環
木櫈 可以推返轉頭 揀面向邊度坐
我一向面向九龍 你一向面向香港
我哋坐埋一齊 面向唔同方向 九年

[Chorus]
九分鐘
海好闊 船好慢 你好近
我而家一個人坐 我唔知要推邊面
我推咗兩次 最後面向海

[Verse]
個海員拋繩 同我細個見到嗰下一樣
船頭撞碼頭 輕輕震一下 我捉住扶手
以前你會笑我「坐咗咁多次仲驚」
而家冇人笑 我仲捉住扶手

[Chorus]
九分鐘
海好闊 船好慢 你好遠
我而家一個人坐 我唔知要推邊面
我推咗返去你嗰面 坐咗你個位

[Outro]
落船
仲有六分鐘到返工
